description: A man seen from behind, in a crimson velvet fur-trimmed robe with a jewelled belt and a curved sword, raises a small card or paper in one hand. He faces a crowd of bearded men in fur-trimmed coats and caps, some with raised hands, in a vaulted stone hall lit by candles and a torch; one man at right wears plate armour. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no letters or numbers and nothing violent.
